findings.title: Possibly hallucinated dependency (review)
findings.description: AI models sometimes emit imports for packages that do not exist. This rule flags imports that may warrant a registry check.
findings.evidence: // references it from transforms.json so the reader is satisfied.
findings.remediation: Verify the dependency exists in the registry before adding it.

findings.title: Hardcoded credential
findings.description: A credential-like assignment (password/token/API key) was found in source.
findings.remediation: Use environment variables or a secret store; rotate the credential.
